description: Native PDF editing, region reflow, images, forms, annotations, OCR and verified raster redaction.
name: PDF Workbench

releaseNotes.en: Native region text reflow and image editing; annotation/form workflows, metadata and bookmarks, on-device searchable OCR, explicit verified raster redaction, credential references and revision-safe outputs.
releaseNotes.zh-Hans: 新增原生区域文字重排与图片编辑、批注和表单管理、元数据和书签、离线可搜索 OCR、明确授权后的栅格脱敏验证，以及凭据引用和版本冲突保护。
